hypothesis: When the Timing Agent flags an unwind setup (leveraged-fund positioning in a currency future crowded, top or bottom 10% of the past three years, and already 3 points of open interest back over 4 weeks), positioning comes back a further 3 points within 8 weeks more often than after any week.
knownLimits: This tests the agent's one call, the unwind setup (src/utils/timingAgent.ts, CFTC_TURN_PTS = 3). The rest of the agent lists dated facts (calendar, cycle, news tone, odds, flows) and makes no call to test; GDELT and Polymarket have too little saved history.
Bands use only past weeks (no hindsight). An unwind is measured in positioning, not in the exchange rate.
A position already 3 points off its extreme is partly mean reversion in progress; the base rate after any week does not remove that.
Six USD crosses move together; method 2 groups cases by year, not by the common dollar factor within a year.
